title: test(dogfood): derive the authz probe reach from the route ledgers; retire the hand-written census
body:
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi99G8ApwiZzLyCouRQisBjZd)_ Fixes #26410 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none Ruling-ref: 6433001130 ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：删掉 dogfood 里 1,691 行手写的权限普查表 `authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts`，`authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` 改成直接从两张路由账本推导：只有账本里出现一行 `discover()` 读不到的路由才红，不再钉任何条数。matrix 注释里两本账的「N rows」也去掉，只留 families / domains 数，#17111 的钉相应只钉组数。 - 为什么改：10 天里 3 次 PR 绿着合进去、main 才红，全是「加了一条路由、条数没同步」。按裁决 C：普查从账本派生，纯数字变动不再红；`discover()` 的 UNCLASSIFIED / STALE 棘轮不动，也不加任何 CI 车道。 - 风险与回滚：只动测试文件和三处注释，不动任何路由代码和发布内容；回滚即 revert。代价是不再记录 rest-server.ts 注册点的盲点读数(那份记录留在 commit 67461403 的历史里)。 - 先看：`packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts`(新的推导检查)，其次 `authz-conformance.test.ts` 的 #17111 段，再看 `authz-conformance.matrix.ts` 第 27 行一带。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts test/authz-conformance.test.ts`，预期 2 个文件、70 个测试全绿。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes **C, as ruled.** The hand-written census `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts` (1,691 lines) is deleted. It pinned per-file registration-site counts, exact positive-control counts, the probe-table shape (25 / 20 / 33) and two blind-spot totals (65 / 70), so every route added anywhere in `@objectstack/rest` had to be re-measured by hand. If it was not, `main` went red after a green merge. `authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` is rewritten to derive everything and pin no count: - **Population and reach come from the ledgers.** For `REST_ROUTE_LEDGER` (`family`) and `ROUTE_LEDGER` (`domain`), the imported table is the population. The ledger probe's own scoped text read (the same `export const NAME` … closing-bracket scope `discover()` uses) is the reach. The test asserts the two line up row by row. It goes red only on a ledger row whose grouping value the probe cannot read. Such a row is a route `discover()` can never name. A row with a literal family or domain moves nothing. - **Kept, derived on both sides:** the matrix header's "`discover()`: N probes over M named source files" must equal the `PROBES` table it describes. Every `PROBES` entry must declare its `kind` before its `file`. All three kinds must still be in use. - **Kept, presence only:** each file a TRIPWIRE probe reads keeps one in-file positive control, so a tripwire's zero still reads the file. Each module on the `RestServer` registrar list must still register routes, since the two `rest-server.ts` tripwires read them all. No exact counts. **The #17111 docblock pin, in place (same defect class).** The claim's premise was "the three reds were all the blind-spot pin". That is only partly true. #26406's before-run shows `authz-conformance.test.ts`'s #17111 pin also red on #26361 (`docblock says 80 rows, the table holds 81`), so deleting the census alone would leave a route-only PR still editing `authz-conformance.matrix.ts`. The matrix docblock now states only `(18 families)` / `(23 domains)`. The pin parses that shape, and the "stale ROW count" doctoring case is gone. The group, deletion, second-copy and anchor cases stay. A new family or domain still moves the figure, alongside the `discover()` classification it needs anyway. The seat amended the claim's file surface for this. **Untouched:** `discover()` and its UNCLASSIFIED / STALE verdicts, the baseline, the matrix rows, every CI workflow. No census step was added to PRs or the merge queue. **Other readers of the census path, re-read before deleting.** None needs the table: | Reader | What it held | Action | |:--|:--|:--| | `packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` | a comment pointer: "the full reading lives in … census.ts" | pointer now names the census at commit 67461403 and its derived successor | | `packages/rest/src/rest-meta-auth.test.ts` | a comment: the test "licenses the census counting those 8 as REACHABLE" | reworded to the ratchet's `meta:rest-server.ts:registerMetadataEndpoints` key | | `authz-conformance.test.ts` (5 comments) | pointers to the census's prose and per-file controls | re-pointed (the controls now live in the new test) | | `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:2822` | a dated incident narrative naming the path | unchanged; it describes a past edit | | `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs:12013` | the path as a change-set fixture for `jobFilteredSteps` | unchanged; pure path-pattern matching, no file read, and the path still lies under `packages/qa/dogfood/**` | No `scripts/pm/**` wording moved, so this PR is not Tier H. ## Why Three `main` reds in ten days (#24057, #25988, #26361 → #26400) came from a PR that changed a counted file and merged green. These census files run only on `main`'s push and scheduled batteries. Every one was a count moving, never an unclassified route. The ruling (6433001130) withdrew a PR-time census step (letter A) and kept C: derive the population, so a bump-only change reds nothing, and leave `discover()` as the only gate. ## Tests
Both files on origin/main 67461403 (before): 108 passed ``` Test Files 2 passed (2) Tests 108 passed (108) os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 19s ```
Both files on bd9b1ea5 (after): 70 passed ``` Test Files 2 passed (2) Tests 70 passed (70) os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 22s ``` The 38 fewer tests are the census's per-file parametrised rows and its table and totals pins, all deleted with it.
Controls on bd9b1ea5: one row added to REST_ROUTE_LEDGER via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored and hash-checked after each leg - **Positive control: a route-only change.** Added `GET /api/v1/approvals/zz-control-probe` with `family: 'approvals'`, an existing family. Result: `Test Files 2 passed (2) · Tests 70 passed (70)`, nothing to edit. The same shape of change on `main` (#26361) needed #26406 (+37/−14 in the census and matrix) to clear 10 reds. - **Negative control: an unclassified route.** Added a row with `family: 'zz-unclassified-probe'`. `discover()` still refuses: `UNCLASSIFIED surface — add a ledger row (ADR-0060): rest-family:rest-route-ledger.ts:zz-unclassified-probe`, and the #17111 families figure reds too. 11 failed / 59 passed. - **Negative control: a row the probe cannot read.** Added a row with `family: 'approv' + 'als'`. `authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` reds on `the probe reads EVERY row`, naming the row. 12 failed / 58 passed. - After each leg: `ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (b6dd2271294b) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
## Acceptance notes - The `rest-server.ts` registration-site blind-spot reading (70 sites, 19 reachable, 51 not) is no longer recorded anywhere live. The route-level bound it measured is still stated in the matrix header: a route inside an existing family mints no key. The full record stays in history at 67461403. - `rest-server-registrar-files.ts`'s header says each reader pins the list's `length`. The derived check walks every module on the list instead, so no length is pinned. That header is not edited here. - Leg 3 also shows a pre-existing probe weakness: `family: 'approv' + 'als'` makes the ledger probe mint a phantom key `approv`, because its pattern stops at the first quote. It is caught twice (UNCLASSIFIED, and the new row-by-row check), so this is noted only. - Dogfood shards run only on `main` push and schedule runs (#24073 stands), so the first CI reading of these two files is after merge. ## Verification All readings on head `bd9b1ea5b0`, clone unshallowed, every package under `packages/**` built (`turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter='./packages/**'`, 75 tasks, under the verify lock). - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: **56** derived commands, every exit captured before any pipe, **56 exit 0**. The first pass had 2 exit-3 prerequisite refusals (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` on the shallow clone, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` without `dist/`). Both exit 0 after unshallowing and building. - `--ran`: `56 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 56 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)`. - The three artifact-roster families whose roster sits under `packages/` were run too: `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing` and `check:filter-alias-parity`, all exit 0. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck`: exit 0, 0 errors. - Not run locally: `@objectstack/rest` and `@objectstack/runtime` tests and typecheck. Their diff is comment-only (three comment blocks). `Test Core` runs them on this PR. - Dogfood shards: not run whole. The title has no `!` and no `(narrowing)` arm. The two affected files are the ones run above. Changeset: `skip-changeset`. `@objectstack/dogfood` is private, and the two `src/` edits in `@objectstack/rest` / `@objectstack/runtime` are comments only. ## Human Minimum - [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched) - [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. - [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (CI-owned) - [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. - [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset. (nothing publishes: `skip-changeset`) - [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a. - [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. - [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English, except the 维护者速读 block. - [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01ADHkmPfdxeQ7cdMHou5dY1 --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_01ADHkmPfdxeQ7cdMHou5dY1)_
